blocks.text: Let's look at this one. Match each inequality with its solution.
blocks.display: Match each inequality with its solution.

blocks.text: Negative five is less than or equal to x minus two, which is less than one. Add two to all three parts: negative three is less than or equal to x, which is less than three.
Two x is less than six and x plus one is greater than negative two. The first part gives x less than three, the second x greater than negative three. Both at once is the overlap.
X plus one is less than zero, or x minus three is greater than zero. The first part gives x less than negative one, the second x greater than three. Either one is enough.
Three x is greater than or equal to six, or x is less than negative four. The first part gives x greater than or equal to two. Both pieces together.
Solve each part the way you solve any inequality. An and gives the overlap and an or gives both pieces. Remember to flip the symbol only when you multiply or divide by a negative number.
